description: Creates a GDScript file, or adds functions, variables and signals to one. Every declaration written carries a type. create loads what it wrote under the project's own warning settings and answers with parses; the engine's reasons for a refusal come back under engine_messages. Operations: create: a new script file; modify (needs modifications): add to an existing script.

className.description: create: a class_name for the script.

content.description: create: the whole file, instead of a template.

extends.description: create: the base class. Default Node.

defaultValue.description: Variables: the initial value, as written in GDScript.

exportHint.description: Variables: the export hint, such as "range(0, 100)".

params.description: Functions and signals: the parameter list, "delta: float".

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

scriptPath.description: Script file inside the project, such as "scripts/player.gd".

name: script_edit
